verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents its own stakeholder access to a centralized platform, a shareholder equity-value visibility setting, permission controls over who views equity data, a 'Create and Share Messages' feature, and a data room for sharing materials. Together these suggest investors can log in to see their holdings and receive messages from the company, but nearly all of this evidence is help-article titles or marketing one-liners. missing for 10: explicit description of an investor-facing portal showing each investor's own holdings, detail on structured investor updates (templates, recurring reporting) beyond a message feature, independent or hands-on corroboration of investor self-service.
